skills.name: Wraith Entanglement
skills.description: Nephtys restrains the nearest enemy for 5s, dealing DMG equal to 60% of ATK per second during this time. The final hit deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK plus 30% of the target's lost HP, capped at 600% of Nephtys's ATK, and knocks down the target and enemies within a 3-meter radius. Nephtys gains Super Armor during this time.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 70% of ATK per second during Restrain.
upgrades.level3: Deals extra DMG equal to 6% of the target's max HP per second during Restrain, capped at 200% of Nephtys's ATK.
upgrades.level4: The final hit's base damage increases to 300% of ATK.

skills.name: Wraithbound Pull
skills.description: Entangles the current target and the enemy unit with the highest ATK, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK to them, then pulls them toward each other. If they collide while moving, deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK and stuns them for 2s.

upgrades.level2: Initial damage increases to 200% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: If the two targets collide, the stun duration increases to 3s.
upgrades.level4: Initial damage increases to 250% of ATK.

skills.name: Everlasting Soul
skills.description: Passive: when Nephtys secures a kill, she gains 15% of that enemy's ATK and max HP, stacking up to 100% of her own ATK and HP.

upgrades.level2: Securing a kill also immediately restores HP equal to 30% of the fallen enemy's max HP.
upgrades.level3: When Nephtys secures a kill, she gains 20% of the enemy's ATK and HP, stacking up to 200% of her own base ATK and HP.
upgrades.level4: Securing a kill also immediately restores HP equal to 50% of the fallen enemy's max HP.

skills.name: Delayed Demise
skills.description: Passive: when Nephtys is about to fall, she uses her shroud to delay falling for 5s. If she secures a kill during this time, she revives immediately. This effect can only trigger once every 25s.

upgrades.level3: This effect can only trigger once every 20s.

relic.name: Soul Harvest
relic.description: While Nephtys is on the battlefield, she continuously absorbs the souls of enemy units. When enemy units on the battlefield take DMG, Nephtys records 10% of the DMG dealt to them, capped at 400% of her ATK. When the limit is reached, it erupts, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK plus the recorded DMG dealt to enemies within a 3-meter radius.

upgrades.level2: Enemies whose souls have been absorbed by Nephtys are infected by her corpse aura, reducing their Armor and M-RES by 15%.
upgrades.level3: Records 20% of the DMG taken, capped at 600% of Nephtys's ATK.
upgrades.level4: Enemies whose souls have been absorbed by Nephtys are infected by her corpse aura, reducing their Armor and M-RES by 30%.
